title: 第6章 卖族求荣的家伙
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

青袍修士微微拱手，语气虽然客气，但那副居高临下的姿态却掩饰不住。

林渊借着对方泄露的一丝灵压，瞬间从老祖的记忆碎片中对上了号。

青阳郡陈家的外务管事，负责陈家在周边的资源搜刮与暗线联络。

更重要的是，在老祖那些阴暗的见闻里，这个陈平身上的功法气息有一丝极淡的血腥与阴冷，与老祖当年接触过的某些血煞门邪修如出一辙。

陈家身为自诩名门正派的筑基修仙世家，暗地里竟然圈养着带有邪修底细的外务管事！

“陈管事，长话短说。”

林崇山脸色铁青，压低声音道，“那老东西，坐化了。”

陈平挑了挑眉，眼中闪过一抹掩饰不住的惊异，旋即又化作贪婪：“此话当真？他当年可是强横一时，怎么会如此突然？”

“遗体老夫已经亲自查验过数遍，全身上下并无斗法痕迹。确实是突破金丹失败，导致灵力逆流、反噬了心脉，死得不能再死了。这也是他活该，寿元本就到了大限，还妄想逆天改命。”

林崇山冷哼一声，语气里竟没有半点对自家老祖的尊崇，反而带着一丝快意。

然而，他很快又咬了咬牙，恨声说道：“只是……出了点意外。那老东西的闭关密室，老夫翻了个底朝天，没找到那枚中品筑基丹！”

听到这里，陈平的脸色瞬间阴沉了下来，眼神如毒蛇般盯住林崇山：

“不见了？林崇山，你莫不是在跟老夫装糊涂？家主之所以愿意暗中支持你掌控林家，可全是因为那枚中品筑基丹！你现在跟老夫说找不到？”

躲在暗处的林渊听到“筑基丹”三个字，心脏不由自主地漏跳了一拍。

一粒中品筑基丹，能够让陈平这种练气九层大圆满多出三成筑基机会，如何不能让人疯狂！

而今，青阳郡三大势力——林家、陈家和刘家，各有一位筑基期修士。

其中，林家老祖乃筑基后期，手段狠厉，还有林崇山这种伪筑基初期，坐拥玄铁矿脉，实力最为强盛。

陈家家主筑基中期修为，家族根基雄厚，族中弟子修为进展极快，属于是对林家最有威胁的家族；

刘家家主为体修，虽为筑基初期，但凭借浑厚气血能跟筑基中期周旋一二，三家之中，实力最弱。

陈、刘两家在林家独大的情况下，已经默契合作多年。

然而现在林家老祖坐化，一旦有一家能多一位筑基期，那将瞬间占据主导地位。

面对陈平的质问，林崇山急忙辩解道：“陈管事，老夫对天立誓，绝没有私吞！那密室里确实没有筑基丹的影子。那老东西生前防老夫防得死死的，或许是他临死前藏在了祖祠的哪个隐秘角落，又或者是被旁系的哪个小辈……”

说到这里，林崇山似乎想到了老祖留下的遗言玉简里提到的旁支林渊，但旋即他又否定了这个想法。

一个毫无根基的旁系炼气九层，怎么可能在老祖眼皮底下偷走筑基丹？

若是已赏赐给他，那老祖遗言该提到此事。

陈平冷笑一声，打断了林崇山的自言自语：

“林崇山，我家主可没心思听你这些推诿之词。目前来看，若你表现出足够的手段，彻底掌控林家并献上筑基丹，陈家自然会继续做你的靠山，像之前一样供你修炼资源，甚至帮你把林家那些不服管教的异己清除得一干二净。”

陈平上前一步，逼视着林崇山，语气中充满了赤裸裸的威胁：

“现在林老祖坐化，照我家主的性子，最多给你三日。三日之后，如果你不仅拿不出筑基丹，连个烂摊子都收拾不干净……那对不住了。我陈家便会与刘家联手，兵临林家山门。到时候，平分了这林家数百年基业，也是一样的结果。你别忘了你的把柄还在我们手上——”

林崇山的脸色瞬间变得惨白，额头上隐隐有冷汗渗出。

他很清楚，没有了筑基老祖坐镇的林家，在陈、刘两家眼里就是一块没有还手能力的肥肉。

The green-robed monk slightly cupped his hands. Although his tone was polite, his condescending attitude could not be concealed.

Lin Yuan took advantage of the trace of spiritual pressure leaked by the other party and instantly made a call from the ancestor's memory fragments.

The external affairs officer of the Chen family in Qingyang County, responsible for the Chen family's resource search and secret contact in the surrounding area.

What's more important is that in the ancestor's dark experiences, the aura of Chen Ping's technique has a hint of blood and coldness, which is exactly the same as some of the blood evil cultivators that the ancestor had come into contact with back then.

The Chen family claims to be a well-known and upright foundation-building immortal cultivating family, but secretly they have a foreign affairs manager with evil cultivator background!

"Manager Chen, let's make a long story short."

Lin Chongshan's face was ashen and he lowered his voice and said, "That old guy has passed away."

Chen Ping raised his eyebrows, a flash of surprise that could not be concealed flashed in his eyes, and soon turned into greed: "Is this true? He was so tyrannical back then, how could it be so sudden?"

"I have personally inspected the body several times, and there are no traces of fighting skills on the whole body. It is indeed the failure to break through the golden elixir, which caused the spiritual power to flow backwards and backfired on the heart. He could not die anymore. This is what he deserves. His lifespan has reached the end, and he still wants to change his fate against the will of heaven."

Lin Chongshan snorted coldly. There was no respect for his ancestor in his tone, but a hint of pleasure.

However, he quickly gritted his teeth and said bitterly: "It's just... something unexpected happened. I searched the old man's secret room and couldn't find the middle-grade foundation-building pill!"

Hearing this, Chen Ping's face instantly darkened, and his eyes stared at Lin Chongshan like poisonous snakes:

"Gone? Lin Chongshan, are you pretending to be confused with me? The reason why the head of the family is willing to secretly support you in controlling the Lin family is all because of that middle-grade foundation-building pill! Now you are telling me that you can't find it?"

Lin Yuan, who was hiding in the dark, heard the words "Foundation Establishment Pill" and his heart skipped a beat involuntarily.

A mid-grade foundation-building pill can give Chen Ping, like Chen Ping, 30% more chance of building a foundation at the ninth level of Qi training. How can it not make people crazy!

Today, the three major powers in Qingyang County - the Lin family, the Chen family and the Liu family, each have a foundation-building monk.

Among them, the ancestors of the Lin family were in the late stage of foundation building and used ruthless methods, while others like Lin Chongshan, who was in the early stage of pseudo-foundation building, were sitting on the black iron veins and were the most powerful.

The head of the Chen family is in the middle stage of foundation building. The family has a strong foundation and the disciples in the family are making rapid progress in cultivation. They are the most threatening family to the Lin family;

The head of the Liu family is a physical cultivator. Although he is in the early stage of foundation building, he can compete with the middle stage of foundation building with his strong energy and blood. Among the three families, he is the weakest.

The Chen and Liu families have been cooperating tacitly for many years despite the dominance of the Lin family.

However, now that the ancestor of the Lin family has passed away, once a family has one more person in the foundation building stage, it will instantly take over the dominant position.

Faced with Chen Ping's questioning, Lin Chongshan hurriedly defended: "Manager Chen, I swear to God that I will never embezzle! There is indeed no trace of the Foundation Establishment Pill in the secret room. The old man guarded me to death. Maybe he hid in a secret corner of the ancestral temple before he died, or maybe he was a junior..."

Speaking of this, Lin Chongshan seemed to think of the side branch Lin Yuan mentioned in the jade slips left by his ancestor, but he immediately rejected the idea.

How could a ninth-level Qi Refining associate with no foundation steal the Foundation Establishment Pill under the eyes of the ancestor?

If it had been rewarded to him, then the ancestor's last words should have mentioned this.

Chen Ping sneered and interrupted Lin Chongshan's soliloquy:

"Lin Chongshan, my family master has no intention of listening to your excuses. At present, if you show enough means to completely control the Lin family and offer the foundation building pill, the Chen family will naturally continue to be your backer, provide you with training resources as before, and even help you eliminate all the dissidents in the Lin family who are disobedient to discipline."

Chen Ping took a step forward and stared at Lin Chongshan, his tone full of naked threats:

"Now that Old Ancestor Lin is sitting down, I will give you three days at most according to my master's temperament. After three days, if you are not only unable to produce the foundation-building pill, but also unable to clean up the mess... then I'm sorry. My Chen family will join forces with the Liu family and come to the Lin family's gate. At that time, the Lin family's hundreds of years of foundation will be equally divided, and the same result will be the same. Don't forget that you still have the handle in our hands - "

Lin Chongshan's face turned pale instantly, and there was a faint cold sweat on his forehead.

He knew very well that in the eyes of the Chen and Liu families, the Lin family without the foundation-building ancestor was just a piece of fat that was unable to fight back.
